_readme: Recent posts, so the assistant can answer 'what has he been saying lately'.
WHY THIS FILE IS HAND-KEPT, NOT FETCHED:
LinkedIn serves no public RSS and has no read API for a personal profile's
posts. The logged-out page truncates every post body at roughly 150
characters, and the browser cannot fetch linkedin.com from drmorgan.ai
anyway (CORS). So the text lives here.
TO UPDATE: open the post on LinkedIn, copy the whole body, paste it as
'text', set 'truncated' to false, and set 'date' to the posting date.
Anything with truncated:true is an excerpt the assistant is told never to
finish for itself. Keep the newest first; twelve are sent to the model.
Delete this file and the assistant carries on exactly as before.
